Backend (Supabase)
Run supabase_schema.sql once in your Supabase project's SQL editor, then connect it here. Everyone can read fair/gallery/artist data once connected; only the signed-in admin account can edit it.
Admin sign-in (required to edit)
Separate from the guest login above. Create this user once under Supabase → Authentication → Users, with email artbyadrielle@gmail.com.
Not signed in.
Import existing data
Pushes the gallery + artist research already built into this file (Armory Show 2026, Independent 20th Century, LENS_ARTISTS_V2) into Supabase. Safe to run more than once — everything upserts.
